No daily traffic

Your reach rises and falls with your posting

670 posts have built 12.6k followers who like how you see life. But new people only find you when today’s post lands. Post less, and fewer people arrive.

A big leap

From a follow straight to 1:1 coaching

Someone who loves your content has nothing small to say yes to first. So the women who aren’t ready to invest in coaching yet keep watching, and never become customers.

No filter

An email inbox treats everyone the same

The curious and the ready both land in the same place. Nothing shows you who has watched you teach, who can invest, and who wants to start now, before you spend time on a reply.

The 95% have nothing to buy from you yet, and the ready 5% look exactly like everyone else.

My recommendation

An always-on £17 masterclass, fed by ads, in front of your 1:1 coaching

Your Instagram and Women in Wellness Club stay exactly as they are. The class becomes a paid front door that ads fill every day: it teaches how you help women love their life again, shows you who is serious, hands the ready ones an application for 1:1 coaching, and pays for the ads that bring in the next class.

Does this sound familiar?

You’ve built a full life. Very little of it is for you.

  • Your diary is packed, and the first thing to go is always your own time.
  • You’re great at looking after everyone else, and last on your own list.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover in 60 minutes

The “good on paper” trap

Why ticking every box doesn’t always add up to a life you love, and the one question that shows you what’s missing.

Boundaries without the guilt

“In the Love Your Life Again Masterclass I’ll walk you through all of it. Live, 60 minutes, £17. Tap Sign up.”
